# three.js, vendored

three.js **r186** (npm `three@0.186.1`), MIT — see `LICENSE`. The same bundled, minified
build as `machine-imaginaire/vendor/three/` (see its README for how it was made), copied
here so each project stands on its own. `index.html` maps `three` to it with an import map;
no addons are needed.
